```yaml
name: CI/CD

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*.*.*'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  ci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu,x86_64-unknown-linux-musl,aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu,x86_64-apple-darwin,aarch64-apple-darwin,x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
          cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: cargo build --all --verbose

      - name: Run tests
        run: cargo test --all --verbose

      - name: Security audit
        run: cargo audit

  release:
    needs: ci
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref_type == 'tags'

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu,x86_64-unknown-linux-musl,aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu,x86_64-apple-darwin,aarch64-apple-darwin,x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
          cache: true

      - name: Build binaries
        run: cargo build --release --target-dir=target/release

      - name: Upload artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: keifu-binaries
          path: target/release

      - name: Create Release
        id: create_release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref }}
          release_name: Release ${{ github.ref }}
          body: |
            ## Changelog
            ${{
              github.event.pull_request.body ||
              github.event.issue.body ||
              ''
            }}

      - name: Upload binaries to release
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: target/release/keifu-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
          asset_name: keifu-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
          asset_content_type: application/gzip

      - name: Upload binaries to release
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: target/release/keifu-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz
          asset_name: keifu-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz
          asset_content_type: application/gzip

      - name: Upload binaries to release
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: target/release/keifu-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
          asset_name: keifu-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
          asset_content_type: application/gzip

      - name: Upload binaries to release
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: target/release/keifu-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
          asset_name: keifu-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
          asset_content_type: application/gzip

      - name: Upload binaries to release
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: target/release/keifu-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
          asset_name: keifu-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
          asset_content_type: application/gzip

      - name: Upload binaries to release
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: target/release/keifu-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip
          asset_name: keifu-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip
          asset_content_type: application/zip
```
